metadata.purpose: Jenny's complete framework for creating unique student narratives
metadata.core_insight: Identity grounds everything - it's not what you do, but who you are doing it

THE_COMPLETE_MASTER_FORMULA.formula: IDENTITY + APTITUDE + PASSION + COMMUNITY SERVICE = UNIQUE NARRATIVE
THE_COMPLETE_MASTER_FORMULA.visual: [Who You Are] + [What You're Good At] + [What You Love] + [How You Serve] = [Your Unique Story]
THE_COMPLETE_MASTER_FORMULA.explanation: Identity is the lens through which all other elements are expressed
THE_COMPLETE_MASTER_FORMULA.why_it_works: Authenticity (identity) + Competence (aptitude) + Drive (passion) + Character (service) = Irresistible narrative

IDENTITY.definition: The unchangeable core of who the student is

huda_example.identity: Indian Muslim girl, quiet personality, immigrant family, minority in tech
huda_example.influence: Shapes her mission to democratize tech for underrepresented communities

IDENTITY.key_insight: Identity isn't a weakness to overcome - it's the authenticity that makes everything else meaningful

APTITUDE.must_connect_to_identity: How does your background shape how you use these skills?

PASSION.must_connect_to_identity: How does your culture/background influence what you love?

COMMUNITY_SERVICE.definition: Using aptitude + passion to serve, especially your community
COMMUNITY_SERVICE.must_connect_to_identity: How does your identity inform who and how you serve?

UNIQUE_NARRATIVE.definition: The story that weaves all four elements into one compelling arc
UNIQUE_NARRATIVE.structure: Because I am [IDENTITY], I use [APTITUDE] and [PASSION] to [SERVICE], becoming [UNIQUE ROLE]
UNIQUE_NARRATIVE.power: No one else has this exact combination of identity + skills + passion + service

huda_complete.identity: Indian Muslim girl, quiet, minority in tech
huda_complete.service: Education for underrepresented groups, AI advocacy
huda_complete.narrative: As an Indian Muslim girl who felt unseen in tech spaces, I combine code and storytelling to create games that make technology accessible and exciting for minorities like me
huda_complete.unique_position: Only she can authentically bridge these specific gaps

anoushka_complete.narrative: As someone who straddles two cultures, I use data and music to translate climate science into cultural movements that resonate across communities
anoushka_complete.unique_position: Her bicultural identity enables unique translation ability

theoretical_example.narrative: As a first-gen Latina who watched my family struggle with diabetes, I combine molecular biology with traditional food wisdom to develop culturally-authentic healthy eating solutions
theoretical_example.unique_position: Only she has the trust and knowledge to bridge science and culture

embrace_not_hide.wrong: Despite being Muslim, I'm interested in tech
embrace_not_hide.right: Because of my Muslim values of education and innovation, I'm driven to democratize tech

specificity_matters.powerful: As an Indian Muslim girl who wore hijab in AP Computer Science...

connect_to_mission.principle: Your identity explains WHY you care about your service
connect_to_mission.example: Having felt invisible in STEM, I create games where girls like me are the heroes

cultural_assets.example: My multilingual background helps me design culturally-responsive AI

opening.formula: Start with identity moment that sparked everything
opening.huda_example: Sitting in my first CS class, the only hijabi in the room, I realized...

development.formula: Show how identity shaped your pursuit of aptitude and passion
development.huda_example: My outsider perspective made me see that coding and storytelling weren't opposites but partners...

service_connection.formula: Connect your service directly to your identity and experiences
service_connection.huda_example: I couldn't let other Muslim girls feel like tech wasn't for them...

future_vision.formula: Project how your unique combination will create change
future_vision.huda_example: At USC, I'll build games that make every girl see themselves as the protagonist of the digital future

mistake_1.fix: Identity is your superpower, not weakness

mistake_2.fix: Identity as strength, perspective, and mission driver

mistake_3.fix: Specific, personal, unique to your exact combination

mistake_4.fix: Show how identity influences every choice

jenny_coaching_wisdom.insight_1: Students often hide what makes them most powerful
jenny_coaching_wisdom.insight_2: Parents sometimes fear identity focus; show them it's strategic advantage
jenny_coaching_wisdom.insight_3: Admissions needs diverse perspectives - identity is VALUE
jenny_coaching_wisdom.insight_4: The quiet Indian Muslim girl in CS is EXACTLY what tech needs
jenny_coaching_wisdom.insight_5: When students own their full identity, confidence soars
jenny_coaching_wisdom.insight_6: Authenticity beats manufactured narratives every time
jenny_coaching_wisdom.master_principle: Your identity isn't baggage to overcome - it's the lens that makes your achievements meaningful and your service authentic

assessment_framework.identity_clarity: How well does student understand and own their identity? (1-10)
assessment_framework.aptitude_alignment: How connected are skills to identity? (1-10)
assessment_framework.passion_authenticity: How much do passions reflect true self? (1-10)
assessment_framework.service_relevance: How directly does service address identity-related needs? (1-10)
assessment_framework.narrative_power: How compelling is the woven story? (1-10)

parent_navigation_for_identity.common_concern: Parents worry identity focus will trigger bias
parent_navigation_for_identity.jenny_response: Identity DISTINGUISHES in a sea of sameness
parent_navigation_for_identity.reframe: Not 'despite being Muslim' but 'because of being Muslim'
parent_navigation_for_identity.evidence: Show examples of students who won by owning identity
